verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.runloop.ai, and doc pages are served as markdown (.md) with a header pointing agents to the llms.txt index. Runloop also documents agent-oriented context: an 'Add context about the Runloop API to your LLMs' page and downloadable Cursor .mdc rule files covering the SDK. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, independent user reports of agents consuming these docs.
